description: Average dwell time inside geofences per geofence type (CD, toll, gas station, client). A visit is a consecutive run of positions inside the same geofence along a trip (from the entry event flagged by analytics_posicoes_geocercas); its duration is last position timestamp - first position timestamp, so a single-position visit counts as 0 minutes. Aggregated grain, so only the processed_at control column applies.
